notes.subject: ישא פני
notes.rationale: Hebrew idiom 'lift the face of' = show favor/accept; rendered 'a tɛna … ɲɛ da' keeping the face image.

notes.subject: i
notes.rationale: Verb תרבה is 2nd-person but pronoun is unexpressed; bracketed 'i' names the adulterer addressed.

notes.subject: כפר
notes.rationale: 'kofer' = ransom/bribe; KJV 'ransom', YLT 'atonement' — here the buying-off payment the guilty man offers.

notes.subject: kalanbaga/adulterer
notes.rationale: The verse turns on the guilty man addressed as 'thou' in תרבה.

translation: A tɛna sɔngoya si ɲɛ da, a tɛna son, hali ni ⟨i⟩ ye jɔnjɔn caman di.
